decisions.reason: The mobile modular processing concept (MMAK) builds directly on the firm's core shredding and screening know-how, and a documented customer saving of over 600,000 euros a year gives management interpretable evidence to learn from and refine it.

The mobile slow-speed shredder sits at the heart of the firm's established competence and has kept a dedicated page for two years, so the firm can readily assimilate feedback and improve it through its own R&D.

This modular concept has a specific reference customer and quantified savings, which shows the firm can apply its environmental-technology knowledge commercially and extend the offer modularly, in line with its strategy.
The newly launched slow-speed shredders are close to the firm's core knowledge base and have their own page, so early market learning is easy to absorb and keeping them carries little risk.

The spiral shaft screens extend the firm's screening expertise with related technology it can interpret and develop further through in-house R&D and university cooperation, so a short time on the market is not a reason to drop them.
